engineNeeds.needs: decode "ascii16" for the `digits` driver (and 17 segment pins: 16 segments + DP; today 7, 8, 14 or 16 pins are allowed and decode needs 7 or 8). Value = bits 5-0 of the RAM field (6-bit ASCII D5..D0 = ASCII & 0x3F: 0x00-0x1F is @ A-Z [ \ ] ^ _, 0x20-0x3F is space ! " # $ % & ' ( ) * + , - . / 0-9 : ; < = > ?). Result bit i drives segmentPins[i] in this order: a1 a2 b c d1 d2 e f g1 g2 h i j k l m DP (bit 16 = DP, the DP comes from the font, not from a dpBit). Table (64 entries, spec file lists each as segment names): 0x00AF7 0x003CF 0x04A3F 0x000F3 0x0483F 0x003F3 0x001C3 0x002FB 0x003CC 0x04800 0x0007C 0x031C0 0x000F0 0x014CC 0x024CC 0x000FF 0x003C7 0x020FF 0x023C7 0x003BB 0x04803 0x000FC 0x090C0 0x0A0CC 0x0B400 0x05400 0x09033 0x04812 0x02400 0x04821 0x09006 0x00030 0x00000 0x10800 0x00084 0x04B32 0x04BBB 0x0DB99 0x0D83A 0x00800 0x03000 0x08400 0x0FF00 0x04B00 0x08000 0x00300 0x10000 0x09000 0x090FF 0x04800 0x00377 0x0023F 0x0038C 0x021B3 0x003FB 0x0000F 0x003FF 0x003BF 0x10000 0x08000 0x08030 0x00330 0x02030 0x04207. A tested patch against the current repo: scratchpad/g2/icm7245-ascii16.patch (converter_load.c, display_out.c, display_out.h; DISP_MAX_SEGMENTS 17, DEC_ASCII16). With it the blockedDevices load and icm7245_test passes. Without it neither device can be loaded.

a second output on a digits-driver device: A2/DISP FULL (inout). In sequential mode (CTRL.SA = 1, MODE high) the chip drives it: high while CNT.N = 8 (display full), else low; in random access mode it is the address MSB input (released). Also required because the parallel bus makes the WHOLE address unknown when one address pin reads Z (converter_par.c address_bits: ok = 0 feeds X for all bits), so sequential entry cannot work while the pin floats; the bench drives A2 as the chip would. Needs e.g. display.extra: [{pin, valueWhen: {...}, enableWhen: cond}] or a `ports` driver beside `digits`.

A1/CLR is a level-sensitive asynchronous clear in sequential mode only: while CTRL.SA = 1 and the pin is low, CH1..CH8 = 32 (blank) and CNT.N = 0, no WR needed. pins.reset is unconditional (it would reset in random access mode whenever address bit A1 is 0) and the `when` form needs a bus transaction. Modeled instead: a clear while a write pulse is active (command x0xdddddd).

pin-level conditions for blank/shutdown: OSC/OFF low = standby (all outputs released, memory kept, DISP FULL released); a pin left open or driven by an external oscillator runs the display. pins.levels reads Z as 0, which would shut an open pin off, so the pin is not modeled. The same would serve the ICM7212 BRT pin (ground = display blank).

(optional, no loader change needed today) an `lcd` driver `decode` (hex / codeB over 4 groups of 7 segment pins) would replace the 4 registers of decoded segment bits and the 64 / 80 constant-valued commands of each ICM7211 variant (the BCD nibble would be stored and decoded at the pins). Also a slave mode for the backplane: with OSC grounded, BP is an input.

notes: newDevices are the four ICM7212 (leddriver, `static` driver, open-drain outputs) and newDevicesLcddriver the four ICM7211 (lcddriver, `lcd` mode static with one backplane BP, frameUs 3333 = half of 150 Hz); both lists must be merged: leddriver.json and lcddriver.json. 16 orderable parts (ICM7211/7212 x {-, A, M, AM} x {IPL 40-lead DIP, IQ 44-lead PLCC}) exist, all from the ordering tables (p.4); footprints PDIP-40-600 and PLCC-44 already exist (body sizes of the drawing p.16 differ by 0.06-0.25 mm from the existing ones; pins, pitch and lead span match). ICM7244/7245 are in blockedDevices (decode ascii16 and 17 segment pins): merge them and MQFP-44-10X10 (missingFootprints) after the patch icm7245-ascii16.patch lands; the font's glyph-to-segment transcription is an image analysis checked glyph by glyph (see the spec). datasheets: the Maxim sheet URL answers a PDF (Safari UA); renesas icm7244/icm7245 URLs answer PDFs (these show the current revision).
